title: The prescribed direct-sum Thom product
statement:
In the finite setting, use the bundle, coefficient and projection comparisons [def-pur-vector-bundle-thom-comparisons]. For bundles $E_1,E_2$ of ranks $r,s$ over a separated finite-type base $B$, and any generator-normalized identification of a rank-$(r+s)$ bundle $E$ with their direct sum, define
$$T_{E_1,E_2}:R\pi_{1!}Q_{E_1}(r)\otimes^L R\pi_{2!}Q_{E_2}(s)\longrightarrow R\pi_!Q_E(r+s).$$
It is exactly the forward six-arrow product [lem-pur-finite-forward-product-symmetry] (symmetry, projection formula, symmetry, proper/open exchange, projection formula, normalized compositor), followed by the canonical equality $p_2\pi_2=\pi$ and compact direct image of the prescribed root-normalized coefficient multiplication. Heterogeneous presentation equalities fix that entire composite and its coefficient arrow uniquely; the definition selects the map from this unique normalization, never an arbitrary isomorphism. The etale-origin witness is a proof of the required property and does not change the map. Both ranks may be zero.
